## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4f2029f945cb3d2abff4b9ae684515801c6909f4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplaceFacetFilters.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceApi.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceTaxonomy.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.taxonomy-31011.test.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.facets-31011.test.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/dead-pack-keys-retired-8754.test.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-taxonomy-labels-31011.test.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans}.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/zh-Hant.ts (generated; read, pinned by zh-hant-generated.test.ts), ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs + ui/packages/i18n/package.json, ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/index.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/index.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/package.json, packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-proxy-plugin.ts, scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, .changeset/config.json, .changeset/30588-marketplace-lazy-namespace.md, .changeset/30206-first-run-checklist.md. The changeset `.changeset/31011-marketplace-taxonomy-facets.md` is a prose face: read for its declarations, not reviewed.

Gate verdicts on this head at review time (check-runs): 25 completed success (Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Build UI Deps, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Type Check · workspace / debt ledger / source gates / consumer gates, every Lint · family, the two required jobs Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check, Auto Label, Check PR Size, filter), 11 skipped (Build Core/Docs, Test Core shards, Dogfood shards, Temporal, UI Published Artifacts, opt-in harnesses), 18 still in progress: Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI 1–16. Nothing has concluded failure. The three in-progress families are the ones that run the i18n gates (`check:i18n-keys`, the zh-Hant pin, the parity test) and `tsc` over `ui/`; the dev reports them green locally on this head, which is a local subset and stands in for none of them.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/i18n` is a published package and its marketplace catalogues are a published surface.** `ui/packages/i18n/package.json`: no `private`, version 18.3.0, `files: [dist, …]`, a row of the fixed release group (`.changeset/config.json:95`), with the subpath export `./namespaces/marketplace` → `dist/namespaces/marketplace/index.js`. The catalogues reach a consumer two ways: at runtime through `loadMarketplaceCatalogue` / `useMarketplaceNamespace` (`namespaces/marketplace/index.ts`, one lazy loader per tag) and, data plus type, through `@object-ui/i18n/locales`, whose `en` is declared `typeof enPack & typeof enMarketplace` (`locales/index.ts:96`) and whose `builtInLocales` carries every language complete. The 认领 rule (语言包键已发布:包导出语言包及其派生类型即发布每个键) applies to every key the diff moves. The seat's reading is RIGHT.
- **The diff narrows that surface.** The `marketplace.category` group — 15 leaves in each of the 11 catalogues — is deleted; the published `.d.ts` of `@object-ui/i18n/locales` loses the `category` member of `en.marketplace` (and of `zh`, `zhHant`, …), and the runtime catalogues no longer resolve `t('marketplace.category.crm')`. A narrowing of a published surface: RIGHT as a fact, and it is the right thing to do (see ④).
- **The diff also widens it.** 28 new leaves per catalogue: `marketplace.facet.*` (3), `marketplace.businessFunction.*` (11), `marketplace.industry.*` (10), `marketplace.solutionType.*` (3), `marketplace.maturity.beta` (1), in all 11 languages. A widening of the same published surface: a fact the PR body describes and the declaration does not carry.
- **`Clause-②: no` (PR body, changeset, and the claim comment it was copied from) is WRONG.** `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` closes the combinations: `yes (narrowing)` is "a diff that widens one surface and narrows another. Both facts are true and both are read." This diff is exactly that, and the stock has three precedents on this package in this shape — `.changeset/30588-marketplace-lazy-namespace.md` (the very namespace these keys live in), `30206-first-run-checklist.md`, `30511-console-packs-platform-locale-tags.md` — each `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` · `Metadata-protocol: none` · `patch`. Correct arm: **`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`**, on both carriers.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none` is RIGHT.** No spec key, accepted value, default or meaning changes; an i18n key is not something a metadata author writes. `packages/spec` is untouched.
- **Level `patch` for `@object-ui/i18n` is RIGHT** under ruling A (`scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, the LEVEL axis: `none` ⇒ every entry `patch`; "a non-protocol … narrowing ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 disposition unchanged"). The `@object-ui/app-shell: patch` entry names a `private: true` package (`ui/packages/app-shell/package.json`) — it publishes nothing and is harmless; Check Changeset accepted it.
- **`Check Changeset` is green and carries no information on this axis.** The gate reads the declaration lines, not the key set; the only cross-checks it has (`added` under `no`, `narrowed` without the arm) are not triggered. A wrong `no` passes it by construction (the #16296 class the arm was introduced for).
- **App-shell surface changes are not published surface.** `MarketplacePackageSummary.category` removed and replaced by `business_functions` / `industries` / `solution_type` / `maturity` typed on the spec's taxonomy; `listMarketplacePackages` drops its `category` parameter (one caller, `MarketplacePage.tsx:415`, passes `{ limit: 100 }` only). `@object-ui/app-shell` is private: RIGHT, no declaration owed for these.
- **Accept-set at the consumer.** `marketplaceTaxonomy.ts` admits only members of `MarketplaceBusinessFunctionSchema.options` / `MarketplaceIndustrySchema.options` / `MarketplaceSolutionTypeSchema.options`; an off-spec value is dropped, the row still lists. `DEFAULT_SOLUTION_TYPE` (`'app'`) for an undeclared type matches `PackageSchema.solutionType.default('app')` (`package.zod.ts:265`); `beta` is `maturity === 'beta'` alone, matching `PackageMaturitySchema` ("absent means stable"). All RIGHT against the spec on `main`.
- **Dynamic-family registry (`ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`).** On `main` the `marketplace.category.` family was already `enumerable: false` (`why: 'runtime-data'`), i.e. prefix-checked only. The head replaces it with three `enumerable: false` / `why: 'external-vocabulary'` entries, each naming the spec enum and the parity test that pins the member set one layer out. Prefix check: unchanged. Member exhaustiveness: now pinned (the parity test fails on a spec value without a label and on a label without a spec value, in every catalogue), which `main` never had for `category`. The declared `why` is the one the gate's own docblock reserves for a vocabulary that "lives in a dependency (`@objectstack/spec`)"; the "bridgeable" repo-local Record it mentions is exactly the second list the card forbids ("a parity test, so no second list exists"). Both ratchet directions (`stale-dynamic-family`, `undeclared-dynamic-family`) are satisfied by the edit, which is why the edit exists. RIGHT — a proper declaration, not a weakening.

### ② Semver level

- Level: `patch` on `@object-ui/i18n` — RIGHT (ruling A; precedents above).
- Kind: `Metadata-protocol: none` — RIGHT.
- Arm: `Clause-②: no` — WRONG on both carriers (PR body and changeset body). Required: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. The arm is the carrier the ADR-0087 gate (`breakingDeclaration`, signal 4) and the queue guard read; with `no`, this head declares no breaking change while publishing a key removal, and the published `CHANGELOG.md` would say nothing to a consumer whose `t('marketplace.category.…')` now renders the key or whose `en.marketplace.category` type access stops compiling.
- What the arm obliges, none of it present on this head (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist §3; `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`): (a) a `**BREAKING**` paragraph in the changeset body with the FROM → TO mapping and the one-line fix — removed `marketplace.category.{crm,erp,hr,finance,project,collaboration,analytics,integration,automation,ai,security,developer-tools,ui-theme,storage,other}`; no one-for-one replacement; the facets an old value maps to are `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING` in `@objectstack/spec/marketplace`, and the console's labels are `marketplace.businessFunction.*` / `industry.*` / `solutionType.*`; the fix for a consumer is to delete the reference or read the facet label; (b) exactly one `adr-0087:` disposition marker (the HTML-comment form the gate prints) — the precedent on this package is `not-required (runtime-interface-only PATH#Symbol)`; note that #30588's operand `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts#TranslationKeys` is no longer accurate for marketplace keys, which left `TranslationKeys` in that very PR — the type that loses the keys here is `typeof enMarketplace` as reached through `en` of `@object-ui/i18n/locales` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/index.ts#en`, or the catalogue module `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/en.ts#en`); the gate's operand grammar decides the exact spelling; (c) a `Skills-docs:` line (os-dev.md: 带 `(narrowing)` ⇒ 按 diff 加写); (d) the full dogfood battery on the final head (os-dev.md: 仅当标题带 `!` 或 `(narrowing)` 臂; review-checklist: 缺 ⇒ REWORK) — the report's `dogfood_battery: n/a — … no (narrowing) arm` rests on the wrong arm; CI's `Dogfood Regression Gate` aggregate is green with its three shards skipped, which measures nothing on this diff.
- `skip-changeset` is not in play and would be wrong: a published package moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation — `ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` edited outside the claim's file surface: judged in ①; a proper declaration that keeps the gate's prefix check and adds member pinning one layer out. `ui/scripts/**` is not a row of the governed register (Governed Surface Queue Guard: success). Accepted; the order's "update the pin with a reason, never delete the gate" is what the diff does.
- Dev deviation — eleven catalogues, not the order's nine: the tree's `MARKETPLACE_LOADERS` has eleven tags and the parity test holds its catalogue set equal to `MARKETPLACE_LANGUAGE_CODES`; all eleven carry the 28 new leaves and none carries `category`. Right. `zh-Hant` is generated (`gen:zh-hant`, OpenCC s2twp with the repo's phrase overrides; `facet.solutionType` reads `型別`); its byte-equality with the generator is the pin test's to say, inside the in-progress Test UI family — not re-run here.
- Dev deviations — A1 outside the lock; the derived-gate loop restarted on the head: process notes with no bearing on the tree; the head's check-runs are the gate verdicts.
- `open_questions`: none declared; none found that the record does not answer below.
- Out-of-scope note 1 (cloud#3661 wire shape, "if cloud serializes the multi-selects differently, the facets stay hidden rather than misreading") — **contradicted by the tree.** `readListingTaxonomy` does `(row.business_functions ?? []).filter(isBusinessFunction)` and the same for `industries`; the proxy streams R2 rows verbatim (`marketplace-proxy-plugin.ts:441-455`, no parse, no schema). A string, number or object in either column throws a TypeError inside `MarketplacePage`'s `useMemo` and takes the catalog page down, not the facet. `null` and an absent key are the only non-array shapes handled. Escalated as **should-fix** (④), not a FAIL: the spec's shape for the camelCase keys is an array and the catalog's select options are the spec's, so the exposure is to a serialization cloud has not yet chosen.
- Out-of-scope note 2 (Expected 5 and the dead `?category=` leg in `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-proxy-plugin.ts:466-480`, carried from #30980's review 6692597068) — the seat's claim (comment 6709209194) splits it to a sibling card the seat files; the card thread carries no sibling number yet. Owed by the seat, not by this PR; the console no longer sends `?category=`, so the leg is dead on this head exactly as #30980's record predicted.
- Out-of-scope note 3 (`OrgPackageSummary.category` and eight older fixtures) — right: the org catalog row is a different wire shape, nothing reads `category` from it, and app-shell publishes nothing.
- The claim comment declared `Clause-②: no` and the dev copied it as os-dev.md says to (认领的两行照抄). The mis-declaration is the seat's first; the correction lands on the PR body and the changeset (the claim is a comment of record and is not edited).

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing against the published spec on `main`:

- `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts:248,342,373`: `Package.category`, `CreatePackageRequest.category` and `UpdatePackageRequest.category` are `retiredKey()` tombstones whose refusal (`retiredCategoryGuidance`) names `businessFunctions`, `industries`, `solutionType` and `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING`. `taxonomy.zod.ts` declares the three closed enums, the maturity flag, `DEFAULT_SOLUTION_TYPE = 'app'`, and `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING` for every old value. The spec on `main` declares no category capability at all; the `marketplace.category.*` labels were the console's copy of the retired enum (15 of the 34 spellings the mapping knows), with no spec declaration behind them. Deleting them takes no declared capability away at the consumer — it makes the spec's own refusal real on the one surface that still spelled the old vocabulary. The taxonomy ruling's console part (card Expected 3: "delete `marketplace.category.*`") is this. The raw-value fallback drop is card Expected 4. Holds.
- The facet semantics against the spec: OR inside a facet, AND across, the spec's order, membership on the spec's `.options`, absent `solutionType` read as `app`, `beta` as the only drawn maturity — each matches `taxonomy.zod.ts`. The tests click rendered buttons and read the `en` catalogue's labels; the eight ablations name the semantic each guards. Holds.
- The i18n parity test is the "no second list" mechanism the card asks for: it iterates the same `.options` the console iterates, both directions, in every catalogue, and additionally pins `maturity` to `['beta']` and the absence of `category`. Holds.
- **Should-fix (robustness, not a FAIL):** `marketplaceTaxonomy.ts` `readListingTaxonomy` — guard the two array columns with `Array.isArray` before `.filter`; the row reaches the console unparsed and the PR's own stated behaviour for a wrong shape ("the facets stay hidden") is only true for `null`/absent. One line each.
- **Should-fix (consistency with the spec's default):** `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` draws the solution type only when the listing declares one, while the catalog page filters and counts the same undeclared listing under `app` (`effectiveSolutionType`). The spec reads absence as `app` in one place (`PackageSchema.solutionType.default('app')`); the console reads it two ways. A visitor who filtered "App" opens Details and sees no type. Draw `DEFAULT_SOLUTION_TYPE` on Details for an undeclared type, or state in the code why Details differs.
- Primary business function is `businessFunctions[0]` after the membership filter, so an off-spec first value promotes the second to primary: consistent with "drawn nowhere" and the spec's 1–3 distinct values; noted, no change asked.
- Client-side filtering over the `limit: 100` page is unchanged from `main` and is Expected 5's sibling by seat ruling; not a finding here.
- **Must-fix (FAIL):** the declaration. A published key removal shipping under `Clause-②: no` with no BREAKING paragraph, no FROM → TO migration and no ADR-0087 disposition is the carrier gap the arm exists to close (`clause2-line.mjs`: "#16296, a value-domain narrowing shipped to consumers with every gate green"). The tree is right; its declaration of itself is wrong on both carriers, and every downstream duty keyed on the arm (changelog migration, ADR-0087 marker, `Skills-docs:`, the dogfood battery) is unpaid as a consequence. Fix: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` in the PR body and the changeset; the BREAKING paragraph with the removed keys and the fix; one `adr-0087:` marker; the `Skills-docs:` line; the battery on the final head; then a fresh record on that head.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-jceu01`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5nLA7wiVY5YWjT9Svr`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2296ac23bfcd2ebf4185a01be3ce993fab5c1359`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplaceFacetFilters.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceApi.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceTaxonomy.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.taxonomy-31011.test.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.facets-31011.test.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/dead-pack-keys-retired-8754.test.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-taxonomy-labels-31011.test.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans}.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/zh-Hant.ts (generated; pinned by zh-hant-generated.test.ts inside Test UI), ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs + ui/packages/i18n/package.json, ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/index.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/index.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/package.json, packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/marketplace/index.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-proxy-plugin.ts, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, .github/workflows/pr-automation.yml (the `Check Changeset` job that runs it), content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (the `Skills-docs:` grammar). The changeset `.changeset/31011-marketplace-taxonomy-facets.md` is a prose face: read for its declarations, not reviewed.

Round 2. The round-1 record on head `4f2029f9` (PR comment 6710167000) FAILed on one must-fix, the declaration and the duties keyed on it, and named two should-fixes. This record judges the tree at `2296ac23` against each of them, not the PR body's account. Authority for the seat running this review itself: the maintainer Leehom, 「你有 fable ，车道契约复审可以自己做」 (2026-11-07T16:00Z); the review was run as an isolated sub-agent fed the card, the PR body and file list, the net diff against `origin/main` and the head's check-runs, and not the dispatch order or the seat's conclusions.

Gate verdicts on this head, read at 2026-11-07T18:06Z and re-read unchanged at 2026-11-07T18:08Z before this verdict: 59 check-runs, 46 `success`, 13 `skipped`, none in progress, none failed. Green includes the required contexts `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` (aggregate and all 16 shards), `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` (aggregate; its three shards are `skipped` at PR speed, the queue leg runs them), plus `Check Changeset` (both runs, the second on the round-2 body patch), `PR-body guards`, `Build UI Deps`, every `Lint ·` and `Type Check ·` family. Skipped: `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Plan Test Core shards`, the Test Core and Dogfood shard matrices, `Temporal Conformance`, `UI Published Artifacts`, the two opt-in harnesses, the schedule gate, and the second run's `Auto Label` / `Check PR Size`. PR state at the same reading: open, draft, `auto_merge` null, head `2296ac23`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Published surface and the narrowing (unchanged from round 1, re-read on this head).** `ui/packages/i18n/package.json`: `@object-ui/i18n` 18.3.0, not private, `exports` carry `./namespaces/marketplace` and `./locales`; `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/index.ts:96-106` declares `en: typeof enPack & typeof enMarketplace` and the same for `zh`, `zhHant`, `ja`, `ko`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `pt`, `ru`, `ar`. The diff deletes the `marketplace.category` group (15 leaves) from all 11 marketplace catalogues and adds 28 leaves per catalogue (`facet.*` 3, `businessFunction.*` 11, `industry.*` 10, `solutionType.*` 3, `maturity.beta`). Removal = narrowing of published surface; addition = widening of the same. Both facts stand. RIGHT.
- **`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`** on the PR body (line 10) and in the changeset body — the arm `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` reserves for a diff that widens one surface and narrows another; precedents on this package `.changeset/30588-*`, `30206-*`, `30511-*`. RIGHT, and the round-1 must-fix's first half.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`** on both carriers. `packages/spec` untouched; an i18n key is not something a metadata author writes. RIGHT.
- **App-shell changes are not published surface.** `ui/packages/app-shell/package.json` `private: true`. `MarketplacePackageSummary` drops `category`, gains `business_functions` / `industries` / `solution_type` / `maturity` typed on the spec's taxonomy types; `listMarketplacePackages` drops its `category` parameter — the only caller on the head is `MarketplacePage.tsx:415` with `{ limit: 100 }`; no `.category` read remains under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/` outside older test fixtures. RIGHT, no declaration owed for these.
- **Accept-set at the consumer (`marketplaceTaxonomy.ts`).** Membership on `MarketplaceBusinessFunctionSchema.options` / `MarketplaceIndustrySchema.options` / `MarketplaceSolutionTypeSchema.options` (the enums at `taxonomy.zod.ts:66,94,129`); an off-spec value is dropped and the row still lists; `effectiveSolutionType` reads an undeclared type as `DEFAULT_SOLUTION_TYPE` (`'app'`, `taxonomy.zod.ts:138`), matching `PackageSchema.solutionType.default('app')` (`package.zod.ts:265`); `beta` is `maturity === 'beta'` alone, matching `PackageMaturitySchema` ("absent means stable"). New on this head: `listOf` — `Array.isArray(value) ? value : []` — guards both list columns before `.filter`, so a string, number or object in `business_functions` / `industries` reads as no values and the facet hides instead of a TypeError in the page's `useMemo`. RIGHT; this closes round-1 should-fix 1.
- **Details page.** `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` now builds `taxonomyGroups` with the solution type always drawn as the `marketplace.solutionType.` label of `effectiveSolutionType(taxonomy)`, business functions and industries only when the listing carries some, and Beta as a badge. The catalog page and Details now read an undeclared type the same way, as the spec does. RIGHT; this closes round-1 should-fix 2.
- **Dynamic-family registry (`ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`).** The `marketplace.category.` entry (`enumerable: false`, `why: 'runtime-data'` on `main`) is replaced by `marketplace.businessFunction.`, `marketplace.industry.`, `marketplace.solutionType.`, each `enumerable: false` / `why: 'external-vocabulary'` — the `why` the gate's own vocabulary reserves (line 955: "the member set exists and is authoritative, but it" lives in a dependency), each naming the spec enum and the parity test that pins the member set one layer out. The gate itself is unchanged; `ui/scripts/**` is not a governed register row (Governed Surface Queue Guard: success). RIGHT.
- **Parity test (`marketplace-taxonomy-labels-31011.test.ts`).** Iterates the same `.options` the console iterates, both directions (a spec value without a label; a label without a spec value), in every catalogue, holds the catalogue set equal to `MARKETPLACE_LANGUAGE_CODES`, pins `maturity` to `['beta']` and the absence of `category`. The card's "no second list" mechanism. RIGHT.
- **Changeset's FROM list** names exactly the 15 keys the `main` catalogue carried (`crm, erp, hr, finance, project, collaboration, analytics, integration, automation, ai, security, developer-tools, ui-theme, storage, other` — the `en.ts` hunk). Its TO points at `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING`, exported from `@objectstack/spec/marketplace` via `export * from './taxonomy.zod'` (`packages/spec/src/marketplace/index.ts:31`). Its locale list matches the `locales/index.ts` export names (`pt`, not `ptBR`). RIGHT.
- **ADR-0087 marker.** Exactly one `adr-0087:` marker in the changeset (counted: 1), `not-required (runtime-interface-only ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/index.ts#MarketplaceCatalogue) …`. The operand resolves: `export type MarketplaceCatalogue` (a readonly string-keyed record of unknown) at `index.ts:87`, the type every lazy loader serves a catalogue as (`index.ts:108`); not a `.zod.ts`, not a `z.input` projection, and the gate's step 4 (no metadata surface references it) is what `Check Changeset`'s step "Require an ADR-0087 disposition on a declared-breaking changeset" (`pr-automation.yml:1001-1002`, `--base $MERGE_BASE`) verified green on this head. Judged on substance: the removed keys have no Zod schema, no spec declaration and no stored row — the #8277 argument the category was built for — and the channel that reaches a consumer is the compiler (typed `en.marketplace.category` access) or the rendered key (`t()`). The symbol whose inferred type literally narrows is the `const en` catalogue (`typeof enMarketplace`), which the operand grammar cannot name (it takes an interface/type/class/enum); `MarketplaceCatalogue` is the declared runtime type the narrowed data is served through, and no closer exported type exists in the namespace (`en.ts` exports only `default en`). Accepted; adding an exported type alias to the published package to name it would itself be a widening nobody asked for. RIGHT.

### ② Semver level
